# google_gemini_data_analytics_data_agent

A DataAgent lets users interact with configured data sources by using
natural language, as part of the Conversational Analytics API.

~> **Note:** Deleting a DataAgent soft-deletes it. A soft-deleted DataAgent
is purged after 30 days (see `purge_time`), and its `data_agent_id` cannot be
reused in the same project and location until then. Changing a field that
forces replacement (such as `kms_key`) while keeping the same `data_agent_id`
therefore fails with an `ALREADY_EXISTS` error; use a new `data_agent_id`
instead.


To get more information about DataAgent, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/conversational-analytics-api/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.dataAgents)
* How-to Guides
    * [Conversational Analytics API overview](https://cloud.google.com/gemini/data-agents/conversational-analytics-api/overview)

## Example Usage - Gemini Data Analytics Data Agent Basic


```hcl
resource "google_gemini_data_analytics_data_agent" "example" {
  location      = "global"
  data_agent_id = "data-agent"
  display_name  = "Example data agent"
  description   = "Example Gemini Data Analytics data agent."

  labels = {
    env = "test"
  }

  data_analytics_agent {
    staging_context {
      system_instruction = "Answer questions about the sample Shakespeare corpus."

      datasource_references {
        bq {
          table_references {
            project_id = "bigquery-public-data"
            dataset_id = "samples"
            table_id   = "shakespeare"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Gemini Data Analytics Data Agent Bigquery


```hcl
resource "google_bigquery_dataset" "dataset" {
  dataset_id                 = "data_agent"
  location                   = "US"
  delete_contents_on_destroy = true
}

resource "google_bigquery_table" "table" {
  dataset_id          = google_bigquery_dataset.dataset.dataset_id
  table_id            = "sales"
  deletion_protection = false

  schema = jsonencode([
    {
      name = "order_id"
      type = "STRING"
      mode = "REQUIRED"
    },
    {
      name = "order_total"
      type = "FLOAT"
      mode = "NULLABLE"
    }
  ])
}

resource "google_gemini_data_analytics_data_agent" "example" {
  location      = "global"
  data_agent_id = "data-agent-bq"
  display_name  = "BigQuery data agent"
  description   = "Example Gemini Data Analytics data agent backed by BigQuery."

  labels = {
    env = "test"
  }

  data_analytics_agent {
    published_context {
      system_instruction = "Answer questions about sales orders."

      datasource_references {
        bq {
          table_references {
            project_id = google_bigquery_dataset.dataset.project
            dataset_id = google_bigquery_dataset.dataset.dataset_id
            table_id   = google_bigquery_table.table.table_id

            schema {
              description  = "Sales orders table."
              display_name = "Sales Orders"
              synonyms     = ["orders", "purchases"]
              tags         = ["sales", "finance"]

              fields {
                name        = "order_id"
                type        = "STRING"
                description = "Unique order identifier."
                mode        = "REQUIRED"
                synonyms    = ["id"]
                tags        = ["identifier"]
                category    = "DIMENSION"
              }

              fields {
                name         = "order_total"
                type         = "FLOAT"
                description  = "Total order amount."
                mode         = "NULLABLE"
                synonyms     = ["revenue", "amount"]
                tags         = ["metric"]
                category     = "MEASURE"
                value_format = "$#,##0.00"
              }

              filters {
                field = "order_total"
                value = "0"
                type  = "ALWAYS_FILTER"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      options {
        model = "LATEST_GA_MODEL"
        analysis {
          python {
            enabled = true
          }
        }
        datasource {
          big_query_max_billed_bytes = 1000000000
        }
      }

      example_queries {
        natural_language_question = "What is the total order value above a threshold?"
        sql_query                 = "SELECT SUM(order_total) AS total_order_value FROM sales WHERE order_total > @min_total"

        parameters {
          name        = "min_total"
          description = "Minimum order total threshold."
          data_type   = "FLOAT64"
        }
      }

      glossary_terms {
        display_name = "Order"
        description  = "A customer purchase transaction."
        labels       = ["sales", "transaction"]
      }

      schema_relationships {
        left_schema_paths {
          table_fqn = "${google_bigquery_dataset.dataset.project}.${google_bigquery_dataset.dataset.dataset_id}.${google_bigquery_table.table.table_id}"
          paths     = ["order_id"]
        }
        right_schema_paths {
          table_fqn = "${google_bigquery_dataset.dataset.project}.${google_bigquery_dataset.dataset.dataset_id}.${google_bigquery_table.table.table_id}"
          paths     = ["order_total"]
        }
        sources          = ["LLM_SUGGESTED"]
        confidence_score = 0.9
      }
    }
  }

  depends_on = [google_bigquery_table.table]
}
```

## Example Usage - Gemini Data Analytics Data Agent Cmek


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {
}

resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member" "kms_iam" {
  crypto_key_id = "kms-key"
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  member        = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-geminidataanalytics.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}

resource "google_gemini_data_analytics_data_agent" "example" {
  location      = "us-central1"
  data_agent_id = "data-agent-cmek"
  display_name  = "CMEK data agent"
  description   = "Example Gemini Data Analytics data agent with customer-managed encryption."

  kms_key = "kms-key"

  data_analytics_agent {
    staging_context {
      system_instruction = "Answer questions about the sample Shakespeare corpus."

      datasource_references {
        bq {
          table_references {
            project_id = "bigquery-public-data"
            dataset_id = "samples"
            table_id   = "shakespeare"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  depends_on = [google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.kms_iam]
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the DataAgent.

* `data_agent_id` -
  (Required)
  Required. The ID to use for the DataAgent, which becomes the final component
  of the resource name. The ID must start with a lowercase letter and may
  contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens, up to 63
  characters in total.


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. User friendly display name. Must be between 1 and 256 characters.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Description of the agent. Must be between 1 and 1024 characters.

* `labels` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Labels to help users filter related agents.
  **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
  Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.

* `data_analytics_agent` -
  (Optional)
  Data analytics agent configuration.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_data_analytics_agent).

* `kms_key` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Customer managed encryption key (CMEK) to use for encrypting the
  DataAgent resources. Cloud KMS CryptoKeys must reside in the same location
  as the DataAgent. The expected format is
  projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_data_analytics_agent"></a>The `data_analytics_agent` block supports:

* `staging_context` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. The staging context for the agent. This context is used to
  test and validate changes before publishing.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_data_analytics_agent_staging_context).

* `published_context` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. The published context for the agent. This context is used by
  the Chat API in production.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_data_analytics_agent_published_context).

* `last_published_context` -
  (Output)
  Output only. The last published context for the agent.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_data_analytics_agent_last_published_context).


<a name="nested_data_analytics_agent_staging_context"></a>The `staging_context` block supports:

* `system_instruction` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. The basic entry point for data owners creating domain
  knowledge for the agent.

* `datasource_references` -
  (Required)
  Required. Data sources that are available for answering questions.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_data_analytics_agent_staging_context_datasource_references).

* `options` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Additional options for the conversation.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_data_analytics_agent_staging_context_options).

* `example_queries` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. A list of example queries for BigQuery data sources.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_data_analytics_agent_staging_context_example_queries).

* `looker_golden_queries` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. A list of golden queries for Looker data sources.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_data_analytics_agent_staging_context_looker_golden_queries).

* `glossary_terms` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Term definitions for the agent's domain.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_data_analytics_agent_staging_context_glossary_terms).

* `schema_relationships` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Relationships between table schemas, including referencing
  and referenced columns.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_data_analytics_agent_staging_context_schema_relationships).

* `user_functions` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. A collection of user functions to be included in context.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_data_analytics_agent_staging_context_user_functions).

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/dataAgents/{{data_agent_id}}`

* `name` -
  Output only. Identifier. The unique resource name of a DataAgent.
  Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/dataAgents/{dataAgentId}

* `create_time` -
  Output only. The time when the data agent was created.

* `update_time` -
  Output only. The time when the data agent was last updated.

* `delete_time` -
  Output only. The time the data agent was soft deleted.

* `purge_time` -
  Output only. Timestamp in UTC of when this data agent is considered expired.

* `terraform_labels` -
  The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
   and default labels configured on the provider.

* `effective_labels` -
  All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


DataAgent can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/dataAgents/{{data_agent_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{data_agent_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{data_agent_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import DataAgent using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    dataAgentId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_gemini_data_analytics_data_agent.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import DataAgent using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/dataAgents/{{data_agent_id}}"
  to = google_gemini_data_analytics_data_agent.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), DataAgent can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_gemini_data_analytics_data_agent.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/dataAgents/{{data_agent_id}}
$ terraform import google_gemini_data_analytics_data_agent.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{data_agent_id}}
```
